messages:
deploy-bot: Production deploy started for prod
Environment: prod
Release: release-rc2
Commit: b9a2c1f
Initiated by: alex_m
Strategy: gradual rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m
---
alex_m: kicking off smoke tests now :rocket:
priya: noted, I'll pin dedicated-pool capacity to avoid preemption during the rollout
sam: quick q — does this include the small DB migration?
alex_m: it's a schema-only, deferred migration; we can toggle if needed
jen_sre: setting alerts for 503 spikes and latency > 500ms for 30m window
deploy-bot: Rollout update: 10% -> 50% after 5m
sam: seeing uptick in 503s hitting /v1/generate from eu-west-1 :thinking_face:
alex_m: can you paste an example log?
sam: logs attached below
jen_sre: ```ERROR: kvcache overflow on shard-3
  at inference.cpp:421
  msg: cache exceeded capacity while serving token 42```
priya: creating a short timeline doc and notifying CS to prepare customer comms if needed
alex_m: ok we are throttling rollout in eu-west-1 back to 10% while we investigate
deploy-bot: Rollback: region=eu-west-1, action=throttle_to_10pct, initiated_by=alex_m, reason=increased_503_rate
sam: after throttling the 503s dropped to baseline, looks like cache pressure on older nodes
priya: can we flip on cache trimming for the cluster and re-trigger canary?
jen_sre: applying cache trim and bumping instance mem overcommit for eu-west-1 now
alex_m: re-triggering canary to 25% for eu-west-1 only
deploy-bot: Rollout update: eu-west-1 10% -> 25% (post-mitigation)
alex_m: smoke tests pass for web and api in eu-west-1 at 25% :white_check_mark:
jen_sre: monitoring for 15m, no regression alerts so far
deploy-bot: Production deploy completed
Summary: release-rc2 promoted to 100% with targeted mitigation in eu-west-1 (throttle+cache trim).
Commit: b9a2c1f
Duration: ~19m
Status: completed with mitigations (no full rollback)
---
alex_m: thanks everyone — follow-up ticket created to replace older cache nodes (ENG-2147)
priya: I'll update release notes and CS notify thread
sam: filing a small postmortem note in incidents channel
jen_sre: will keep alerts on for the rest of the day :hourglass_flowing_sand:
:thumbsup:
